title: Employment Verification Letter Template
description: Free employment verification letter template for confirming job status, income, and employment details.
intro: This employment verification letter template is used by employers and HR departments to confirm an employee’s current or past employment status. It can be used for rental applications, loan applications, immigration processes, and background checks.
whenToUse: Use this template when an employee, bank, landlord, or government agency requests official proof of employment.
template:
To Whom It May Concern,

This letter confirms that [Employee Name] is employed with [Company Name] as a [Job Title]. [Employee Name] has been employed with the company since [Start Date].

Current employment status: [Full-Time/Part-Time]
Current salary: [Salary Information]

If you require additional information, please contact us at [Phone Number] or [Email Address].

Sincerely,
[Employer Name]
[Company Name]
example:
To Whom It May Concern,

This letter confirms that Sarah Johnson is employed with ABC Solutions as a Marketing Manager. Sarah has been employed with the company since June 2022.

Current employment status: Full-Time
Current salary: $72,000 annually

Sincerely,
Michael Brown
ABC Solutions
tips: Use official company letterhead if possible.
Only include salary information if authorized by the employee.
Double-check employment dates for accuracy.
Keep the tone formal and professional.

faqs.question: What is an employment verification letter?
faqs.answer: An employment verification letter confirms a person’s job status, role, and employment details.

faqs.question: Who requests employment verification letters?
faqs.answer: Landlords, banks, immigration agencies, and lenders commonly request them.

faqs.question: Should salary information be included?
faqs.answer: Salary details should only be included when necessary and authorized.

title: Termination Letter Template

[Company Name]

This agreement is made between [Roommate 1 Name] and [Roommate 2 Name].

[How rent and bills will be split]

[How household tasks will be divided]

[Rules for guests, noise, shared spaces]

[How long the agreement lasts]

[Roommate 1 Name]
[Roommate 2 Name]

Sarah Lee
